requirement: docs/r1/隐藏角色-彩虹泡泡出图需求.md
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production sprite for the hidden character of a bright all-ages mobile bubble puzzle game.
Generate one single cute round rainbow jelly bubble, no face or limbs. Match polished glossy cute 2D cartoon character sprites: rounded plump volume, clean violet-blue ink outline, soft cel shading with smooth limited gradients, rich soft candy colors. Not realistic glass or an empty soap bubble; an opaque juicy candy-jelly sphere.

Canvas/composition: portrait 224x256 logical transparent canvas. Bubble about 150 logical pixels wide (two-thirds canvas width), centred horizontally at x=112. Bottom sits at y=212, leaving 44 transparent pixels below and generous empty transparent margins on both sides and above. Almost circular, only subtly squashed flat at the very bottom as if sitting; no base. One isolated bubble, fully visible.

Surface: soft pastel rainbow gradient of pink, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet flowing diagonally across and following the round surface, bright but not neon, no hard rainbow stripes. Clean single dark violet-blue outer outline approximately #3A2A8A, about 2 to 3 logical pixels thick. Soft cel shaded dimensional bottom/right, one large white specular highlight on the upper-left and one small highlight near it, one pale reflection along the inner lower rim. No extra outer white stroke or glow.

Text (verbatim): "?"
Three to five white question marks scattered ON the sphere surface, varying sizes, some slightly tilted. Use four clearly legible question marks: one dominant mark about 30 percent of the bubble width, three smaller supporting marks. Each is white with a thin dark violet-blue outline that is distinct on the rainbow background. Keep question marks fully inside the sphere, with clear separation, do not let them look like eyes or a face. Round friendly bold glyphs, with clearly separate dots. Exactly question marks; no other symbols, letters or numbers.

Avoid: face, eyes, mouth, nose, hands, feet, ears, tail, ribbon, candy wrapper ends, ground shadow, pedestal, background, checkerboard pattern baked into the image, texture grain, sparkles outside the bubble, extra objects, watermark, labels.
Produce a genuine transparent-background RGBA image.

postprocess.operation: Crop transparent margins with 6 source-pixel padding; proportional Lanczos3 resize; position on transparent canvas. No repainting.

gameIntegration: Existing optional atlas slot confirmed by reading scripts/r1v3/build_atlas_v3.py. No code changes or build.
